title: Import SRD Poisons and Diseases as structured hazard records
description: The Poisons (14 named poisons: type/price/save DC/damage/effect) and Diseases (Cackle Fever, Sewer Plague, Sight Rot) gamemastering sections are not in any importer slice and are entirely absent from the pack. They are description-only dangers with save DCs and effects -- the same shape as traps, which were folded into the 'hazard' kind (loreweaver-hvp). Add anchors for the Poisons and Diseases sections (they sit after Spell Descriptions, near Traps), parse each entry, and emit under 'hazard' with data.category 'poison'/'disease'. Do NOT mint new record kinds (would force edits across exhaustive Record<RulesRecordKind> validators). See docs/audits/srd-5.1-rules-section-coverage.md (loreweaver-ars), sections #17/#20 and Note B.
notes: Implementation complete; PR #159 open for review (https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/159). Pack regenerated (8->25 hazards: +3 diseases, +14 poisons), purely additive; includes an extractor column-split fix for the p205 inline-lead-in layout. Close on merge.
close_reason: Merged to main via PR #159 (feat(srd): import Poisons and Diseases as structured hazard records).
